info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Wholesale Trading Credit Risk Operations-spec
info.description: The Wholesale Trading Credit Risk Operations API provides stakeholders with access to credit risk information specific to wholesale trading activities. It enables users to query and retrieve comprehensive data on credit risk operations, facilitating informed decision-making and risk assessments. This API is particularly beneficial for traders, risk analysts, and compliance officers who need to evaluate credit exposures and manage financial risks. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their risk management strategies and ensure regulatory compliance.

get.summary: Retrieve credit risk operations data for wholesale trading.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current credit risk operations data related to wholesale trading activities. It provides insights into the performance and risk exposure inherent in the wholesale trading sector.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve credit risk operations related to wholesale trading. It is essential for accessing specific data points required for assessing credit risks effectively.
